Agent brief:
Ask an agent to propose a minimal context package for implementing a reservation edit. Review sources of truth, excluded files and how it handles conflicting documents.
Review criteria:

items.t: State the expected behavior and at least one failure or edge case before asking an agent to implement anything.
Inspect the boundary conditions and dependency direction, not only the happy-path result.
Demand observable evidence: tests, measured results, or a justified design decision.
